{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","id":"msg_vrtx_01M3XNr2KTReyVtBpHaU6Kv4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_vrtx_012g26rE1T2NZAWVJUiPqA2P","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/workspace/extract_receipt_data.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport os\nimport re\nfrom PIL import Image\nimport pytesseract\nfrom openpyxl import Workbook\nfrom openpyxl.utils.dataframe import dataframe_to_rows\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# Paths\nIMG_DIR = \"/app/workspace/dataset/img\"\nOUTPUT_FILE = \"/app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx\"\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(img_path):\n    \"\"\"Extract text from image using Tesseract OCR.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        img = Image.open(img_path)\n        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)\n        return text\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"Error extracting text from {img_path}: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\ndef extract_date(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract date from receipt text and convert to ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).\"\"\"\n    # Look for date patterns\n    # Common patterns: DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, etc.\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{4})',  # DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'(\\d{2})/(\\d{2})/(\\d{4})',  # DD/MM/YYYY\n        r'(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})',  # YYYY-MM-DD\n        r'(\\d{2})\\s+([A-Za-z]+)\\s+(\\d{4})',  # DD Month YYYY\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.findall(pattern, text)\n        if matches:\n            match = matches[0]\n            try:\n                # Try DD-MM-YYYY format\n                if len(match[0]) == 2 and len(match[2]) == 4:\n                    day, month, year = match[0], match[1], match[2]\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(f\"{day}-{month}-{year}\", \"%d-%m-%Y\")\n                    return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                # Try YYYY-MM-DD format\n                elif len(match[0]) == 4:\n                    year, month, day = match[0], match[1], match[2]\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(f\"{year}-{month}-{day}\", \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                    return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n            except ValueError:\n                continue\n\n    return None\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract total amount from receipt text.\"\"\"\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority keywords\n    priority_keywords = [\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+RM|TOTAL:\\s+RM', 2),\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        (r'TOTAL|AMOUNT|TOTAL\\s+DUE|AMOUNT\\s+DUE|BALANCE\\s+DUE|NETT\\s+TOTAL|NET\\s+TOTAL', 4)\n    ]\n\n    # Exclusion keywords\n    exclusion_keywords = ['SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST', 'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED']\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = float('inf')\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        # Skip if exclusion keyword is in line\n        if any(keyword in line.upper() for keyword in exclusion_keywords):\n            continue\n\n        line_upper = line.upper()\n\n        # Check priority keywords\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in priority_keywords:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Try to extract amount from the same line\n                amount_match = re.search(r'(\\d+(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}|\\d+\\.\\d{2})', line)\n                if amount_match:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    if priority < best_priority:\n                        best_match = amount_str\n                        best_priority = priority\n                else:\n                    # Try next line if amount is not on the same line\n                    if i + 1 < len(lines):\n                        next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                        amount_match = re.search(r'(\\d+(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}|\\d+\\.\\d{2})', next_line)\n                        if amount_match:\n                            amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                            if priority < best_priority:\n                                best_match = amount_str\n                                best_priority = priority\n\n    return best_match\n\ndef process_receipts():\n    \"\"\"Process all receipt images and extract data.\"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get sorted list of image files\n    img_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(IMG_DIR) if f.endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))])\n\n    for filename in img_files:\n        img_path = os.path.join(IMG_DIR, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        # Extract text from image\n        text = extract_text_from_image(img_path)\n\n        # Extract date\n        date = extract_date(text)\n\n        # Extract total amount\n        total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n        results.append({\n            'filename': filename,\n            'date': date,\n            'total_amount': total_amount\n        })\n\n    return results\n\ndef write_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"Write results to Excel file.\"\"\"\n    # Create workbook and select active sheet\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write header\n    ws['A1'] = 'filename'\n    ws['B1'] = 'date'\n    ws['C1'] = 'total_amount'\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for idx, result in enumerate(results, start=2):\n        ws[f'A{idx}'] = result['filename']\n        ws[f'B{idx}'] = result['date']\n        ws[f'C{idx}'] = result['total_amount']\n\n    # Save workbook\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results written to {output_path}\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    results = process_receipts()\n    write_to_excel(results, OUTPUT_FILE)\n"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":4,"cache_creation_input_tokens":249,"cache_read_input_tokens":20730,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":249,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":1},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b250e635-1666-4042-a9e9-2c8385cf7825","uuid":"ac08864d-e816-4d2e-bea8-a7b0279b8b5b"}

Look for date patterns\n    # Common patterns: DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, etc.\n    date_patterns = [\n        r'(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{4})',  # DD-MM-YYYY\n        r'(\\d{2})/(\\d{2})/(\\d{4})',  # DD/MM/YYYY\n        r'(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})',  # YYYY-MM-DD\n        r'(\\d{2})\\s+([A-Za-z]+)\\s+(\\d{4})',  # DD Month YYYY\n    ]\n\n    for pattern in date_patterns:\n        matches = re.findall(pattern, text)\n        if matches:\n            match = matches[0]\n            try:\n                # Try DD-MM-YYYY format\n                if len(match[0]) == 2 and len(match[2]) == 4:\n                    day, month, year = match[0], match[1], match[2]\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(f\"{day}-{month}-{year}\", \"%d-%m-%Y\")\n                    return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                # Try YYYY-MM-DD format\n                elif len(match[0]) == 4:\n                    year, month, day = match[0], match[1], match[2]\n                    date_obj = datetime.strptime(f\"{year}-{month}-{day}\", \"%Y-%m-%d\")\n                    return date_obj.strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d\")\n            except ValueError:\n                continue\n\n    return None\n\ndef extract_total_amount(text):\n    \"\"\"Extract total amount from receipt text.\"\"\"\n    lines = text.split('\\n')\n\n    # Priority keywords\n    priority_keywords = [\n        (r'GRAND\\s+TOTAL', 1),\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+RM|TOTAL:\\s+RM', 2),\n        (r'TOTAL\\s+AMOUNT', 3),\n        (r'TOTAL|AMOUNT|TOTAL\\s+DUE|AMOUNT\\s+DUE|BALANCE\\s+DUE|NETT\\s+TOTAL|NET\\s+TOTAL', 4)\n    ]\n\n    # Exclusion keywords\n    exclusion_keywords = ['SUBTOTAL', 'SUB TOTAL', 'TAX', 'GST', 'SST', 'DISCOUNT', 'CHANGE', 'CASH TENDERED']\n\n    best_match = None\n    best_priority = float('inf')\n\n    for i, line in enumerate(lines):\n        # Skip if exclusion keyword is in line\n        if any(keyword in line.upper() for keyword in exclusion_keywords):\n            continue\n\n        line_upper = line.upper()\n\n        # Check priority keywords\n        for keyword_pattern, priority in priority_keywords:\n            if re.search(keyword_pattern, line_upper):\n                # Try to extract amount from the same line\n                amount_match = re.search(r'(\\d+(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}|\\d+\\.\\d{2})', line)\n                if amount_match:\n                    amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                    if priority < best_priority:\n                        best_match = amount_str\n                        best_priority = priority\n                else:\n                    # Try next line if amount is not on the same line\n                    if i + 1 < len(lines):\n                        next_line = lines[i + 1]\n                        amount_match = re.search(r'(\\d+(?:,\\d{3})*\\.\\d{2}|\\d+\\.\\d{2})', next_line)\n                        if amount_match:\n                            amount_str = amount_match.group(1).replace(',', '')\n                            if priority < best_priority:\n                                best_match = amount_str\n                                best_priority = priority\n\n    return best_match\n\ndef process_receipts():\n    \"\"\"Process all receipt images and extract data.\"\"\"\n    results = []\n\n    # Get sorted list of image files\n    img_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(IMG_DIR) if f.endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'))])\n\n    for filename in img_files:\n        img_path = os.path.join(IMG_DIR, filename)\n        print(f\"Processing {filename}...\")\n\n        # Extract text from image\n        text = extract_text_from_image(img_path)\n\n        # Extract date\n        date = extract_date(text)\n\n        # Extract total amount\n        total_amount = extract_total_amount(text)\n\n        results.append({\n            'filename': filename,\n            'date': date,\n            'total_amount': total_amount\n        })\n\n    return results\n\ndef write_to_excel(results, output_path):\n    \"\"\"Write results to Excel file.\"\"\"\n    # Create workbook and select active sheet\n    wb = Workbook()\n    ws = wb.active\n    ws.title = \"results\"\n\n    # Write header\n    ws['A1'] = 'filename'\n    ws['B1'] = 'date'\n    ws['C1'] = 'total_amount'\n\n    # Write data rows\n    for idx, result in enumerate(results, start=2):\n        ws[f'A{idx}'] = result['filename']\n        ws[f'B{idx}'] = result['date']\n        ws[f'C{idx}'] = result['total_amount']\n\n    # Save workbook\n    wb.save(output_path)\n    print(f\"Results written to {output_path}\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    results = process_receipts()\n    write_to_excel(results, OUTPUT_FILE)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":4,"oldLines":8,"newStart":4,"newLines":6,"lines":[" from PIL import Image"," import pytesseract"," from openpyxl import Workbook","-from openpyxl.utils.dataframe import dataframe_to_rows","-import pandas as pd"," from datetime import datetime"," "," #
